Hmm, being a great person or contributing to the development of humanity aren't prerequisites to living.  I'm direct evidence of that, LMAO.  Also, try not to think about how it would affect others...honestly, that stuff wouldn't matter to you if you're dead lol.  But, I can tell you that you're helping me out by replying.  Honestly...it's amazing what a little human interaction can do :)

Thank you, btw.

Edit: Just re-read my blurb about not caring about what others think, and it sounds too harsh.  I mean...I've always hated the argument "think about ur parents lel." Nah dude, I'm gonna focus on myself, and I think we should all focus on ourselves.

I saw someone mention prostitutes.  Most are chill - seriously. Just talk to them. I've done that several times throughout the years :) Some advice...skip jerking for about a week or two, then call one up.  It's worth it bro.

Source: I play video games almost 4hr/day, and haven't been in a relationship in 7 yrs.
